lines: Are the monkey bars at the playground not fun anymore?
Maybe it’s time to try rock climbing!
Rock climbing is a good exercise for your body and mind.
Imagine you are climbing a wall.
The climbing wall is very high.
It has many big and small climbing rocks.
You move your hands and feet.
A safety belt and rope keep you from falling!
body.text: Are the monkey bars at the playground not fun anymore? Maybe it’s time to try rock climbing! Rock climbing is a good exercise for your body and mind. Imagine you are climbing a wall. The climbing wall is very high. It has many big and small climbing rocks. You carefully choose some rocks. You move your hands and feet. Then, you climb the wall. You try not to fall. You stay focused and calm. Are you worried about falling? Don’t worry. Rock climbing is safe. A safety belt and rope keep you from falling!
